heroHeadline: Houthis Strike Saudi Airports, Killing Three as GCC Condemns Attacks
heroSubtitle: Houthi forces struck multiple Saudi airports, killing at least three people and injuring dozens. The GCC Secretary-General condemned the strikes as violations of international law targeting civilian aviation, while Turkey's newly announced military backing for Saudi Arabia signals deepening regional involvement in the Yemen conflict.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
